solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Small fish always around lake

indicators.note: around tells us the word for always wraps round the letter for lake

parts.note: ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: An angler's tiny catch that is forever found near a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Elvers are young eels, slender little fish that swarm up rivers from the sea.

clue.text: Cover of English novel redesigned with purple on the outside

indicators.note: redesigned means given a new arrangement, so the letters of 'novel' are shuffled
on the outside means take only the outer letters of 'purple', its first and last

explanation.surface: A new edition of an English novel with a purple dust jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redesigned' turns NOVEL into NVELO; the outer letters of 'purple' are P and E.
explanation.definitionFit: An envelope is a paper wrapper or covering, especially one for a letter.

clue.text: Sparkle you can see in silver vessel

indicators.note: you can see in says the letters sit in plain view inside 'silver vessel'

explanation.surface: The gleam of a polished silver pot catching the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: Verve is lively energy and enthusiasm, the kind of sparkle a vivid performance has.

clue.text: Put back what can control art gallery

parts.note: reins are the straps a rider uses to control a horse
the Tate is the famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: A curator asking what can be used to manage a gallery that has been put back together.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstate is to restore someone or something to a former position.

clue.text: A lot of excellent aluminium is essential

indicators.note: a lot of, not all of, says the word for excellent loses its final letter

parts.note: prime means of top quality, as in prime beef
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: A boast that plenty of top-grade aluminium is indispensable, as if from a metals trader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excellent' looks like praise for the metal, but it supplies its own letters; 'A lot of' means most of that word, not all.
explanation.definitionFit: Primal can mean fundamental or of first importance, so it fits a basic, necessary quality.

clue.text: Make fun of newspaper

definitions.meaning: to tease or mock someone playfully
a disparaging word for a poor-quality newspaper

explanation.surface: Mocking a newspaper, as satirists like to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Rag is both a verb for teasing and a slangy noun for a low-grade tabloid paper.

clue.text: Cocktail made with skill in small car

indicators.note: in says the word for skill sits inside the name of the small car

parts.note: the Mini is a famous small British car
art means skill, as in the art of persuasion

explanation.surface: A bartender expertly mixing a drink in a tiny car.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a classic cocktail of gin or vodka with vermouth.

clue.text: Place where officer has ejected tenant?

indicators.note: has ejected says the word 'tenant' is thrown out of the officer's rank

parts.note: a lieutenant is a military officer

explanation.surface: A landlord officer evicting a lodger from somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Place' is the noun as in 'in place of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieu means place, used in the phrase 'in lieu of', meaning instead of.

clue.text: Very large inset I blame for resetting

indicators.note: resetting means setting in a new order, so the letters of 'inset I blame' are rearranged

explanation.surface: A printer blames a huge inset on someone resetting the page.
explanation.definitionFit: Inestimable means too great to be measured or calculated, hence immense.

clue.text: Dislike destroying a particular edition

indicators.note: destroying the letter given by the clue's 'a' means removing it from the word for dislike

parts.note: an aversion is a strong dislike

explanation.surface: Someone's hatred leads them to destroy one specific printing of a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroying a' removes the A from AVERSION.
explanation.definitionFit: A version is one specific form or variant of something, like a particular release of a text.

clue.text: Son covered in blood in spiny bush

indicators.note: covered in says the son's letter is wrapped inside the word for blood

parts.note: gore is spilt blood
S is the standard abbreviation for son, as in family trees

explanation.surface: A grisly scene of a boy bloodied after tumbling into a prickly shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorse, also called furze, is a yellow-flowered shrub with sharp thorns, common on heathland.

clue.text: Fabrication of lino is expensive to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with tells us to take the opening letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: A claim that cheap floor covering is costly is a lie.
explanation.definitionFit: A fabrication is an invented untruth, a falsehood made up to deceive.

clue.text: Rebuilt city mess affecting an entire body

indicators.note: rebuilt means put together again in a new form, so the letters of 'city mess' are rearranged

explanation.surface: A messy city that has been rebuilt, a problem touching the whole body politic.
explanation.definitionFit: Systemic describes something, such as a disease or a pesticide, spread throughout a whole organism or system.

clue.text: European girl's shoulder pad

parts.note: Paulette is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A European girl's padded jacket shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: An epaulette is an ornamental shoulder piece on a uniform, a decorative pad on the shoulder.

clue.text: Place below Arundel, crumbling over years

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the shuffled town above the letter for years
crumbling suggests falling apart, so the letters of 'Arundel' are rearranged

explanation.surface: Arundel, its castle crumbling over the years, is a place below.
explanation.walkthrough: Arundel is a historic castle town in West Sussex, England; 'crumbling' shuffles it to UNDERLA.
explanation.definitionFit: To underlay is to lay or place something beneath another thing, as underlay goes under carpet.

clue.text: Being evasive before holiday taking in Rhode Island

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before

indicators.note: taking in says the word for holiday swallows the state's abbreviation

parts.note: vacation is a holiday
RI is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Rhode Island

explanation.surface: Someone dodging questions before a trip that includes a stop in Rhode Island.
explanation.definitionFit: Prevarication is speaking or acting evasively to avoid the truth, the noun for dodging.

clue.text: Great joy when sister, say, dismisses Romeo

indicators.note: dismisses says the letter for Romeo is sent away from the word for a sister

parts.note: a sister is an example of a relation, a family member
Romeo is the NATO phonetic alphabet word for R

explanation.surface: A sister is thrilled to send her boyfriend Romeo packing.
explanation.definitionFit: Elation is a state of intense happiness and high spirits.

clue.text: Hop on foot in game

indicators.note: on in an across clue puts the dance word after the word for foot

parts.note: the foot of something is its base or bottom
a hop is an informal dance, as is a ball

explanation.surface: Hopping on one foot as part of a playground game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hop' looks like a movement but is a dance, as a ball is.
explanation.definitionFit: Baseball is the American bat-and-ball sport, played by two teams of nine on a diamond.

clue.text: Regularly crude sign

indicators.note: regularly says take every other letter of 'crude', starting with the first

explanation.surface: A rough gesture that is made over and over again.
explanation.definitionFit: A cue is a signal to act, such as an actor's prompt to come on stage.

clue.text: Unit caught a traitor

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a rat is someone who betrays others

explanation.surface: A police unit has caught a traitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A carat is a unit of weight for gems, or a measure of gold's purity.

clue.text: Fine deed in truth

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
an act is a deed

explanation.surface: A noble deed that really happened.
explanation.definitionFit: A fact is something known to be true, so facts collectively are the truth.

clue.text: Foreign article includes falsehood

indicators.note: includes says the article holds the word for falsehood inside it

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a lie is a falsehood

explanation.surface: An overseas newspaper piece that contains an untruth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'article' looks like a newspaper piece but is the grammatical article AN.
explanation.definitionFit: Alien as an adjective means belonging to another country or unfamiliar, strange.

clue.text: Love extracting energy from river

indicators.note: extracting says the letter for energy is pulled out of the river's name

parts.note: the Nile is the great African river
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Harnessing hydroelectric energy from a river.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis scoring love means zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Love is the tennis term for a score of zero, and nil also means nothing.

clue.text: Following a line sideways

parts.note: later means following on in time

explanation.surface: Instructions to keep to a line while moving sideways, like a crab.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral means relating to the side, so lateral movement is movement to the side.

clue.text: Seaweed beginning to trap fish

indicators.note: beginning to means take just the opening letter of 'trap'

parts.note: to angle is to fish with rod and line

explanation.surface: Fronds of seaweed starting to snare fish swimming by.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangle is a name for a large brown kelp, the oarweed, found in coastal waters.

clue.text: Guard missing second way in

indicators.note: missing says the word for guard has the letter for second taken away

parts.note: a sentry is a soldier posted on guard

explanation.surface: A guard absent for a moment leaves the doorway open.
explanation.definitionFit: An entry is an entrance, a door or passage through which one goes inside.
